description: This file contains utility functions, classes, and internal mechanisms used throughout the TorchDynamo system, including performance metrics collection, compilation timing, graph utilities, logging, profiling, and interaction with PyTorch internals. It provides internal support for performance monitoring, debugging, and visualization within the TorchDynamo and Torch project.

classes.name: ReInplaceTrigger
classes.description: Enumeration representing different triggers for inplace re-integration (e.g., AUTO_FUNC_V1, AUTO_FUNC_V2, TRITON_OPS).

classes.name: ReinplaceCounters
classes.description: Class managing counters for missed inplace re-integration opportunities and total missed bytes, with methods to add, clear, retrieve, and log counters.

classes.name: CompilationMetrics
classes.description: Dataclass capturing various metrics related to a compilation, including timing, counts, status, and version info. Provides a factory method to construct from a dictionary.

classes.name: ChromiumEventLogger
classes.description: Class for structured logging of Chromium trace events, managing event stack and metadata, generating logs for profiling and debugging tools.

classes.name: CompileEventLogLevel
classes.description: Enum defining log levels: CHROMIUM, PT2_COMPILE, COMPILATION_METRIC, each indicating the depth of logging detail.

methods.name: tabulate
methods.description: Creates a textual table representation from rows and headers, with fallback to CSV format if tabulate library is unavailable.

methods.name: increment_frame
methods.description: Increments the current frame counter, tracking iteration progress in the system.

methods.name: reset_frame_count
methods.description: Resets the frame counter and clears cumulative timing data.

methods.name: register_hook_for_recompile_user_context
methods.description: Registers a callback hook that provides context information during recompilation triggers.

methods.name: get_hook_for_recompile_user_context
methods.description: Retrieves registered hooks for recompile user context, if any.

methods.name: reset_recompile_user_contexts
methods.description: Clears all registered recompile user context hooks.

methods.name: increment_op_count
methods.description: Increments the global operation count by a specified amount.

methods.name: calculate_time_spent
methods.description: Calculates total time spent in different phases, converting nanoseconds to seconds and aggregating timings.

methods.name: print_time_report
methods.description: Prints a structured report of timing metrics accumulated so far.

methods.name: get_metrics_context
methods.description: Returns the thread-local MetricsContext instance for collecting compilation metrics.

methods.name: get_runtime_metrics_context
methods.description: Returns the RuntimeMetricsContext instance for runtime metrics collection.

methods.name: get_chromium_event_logger
methods.description: Returns the singleton ChromiumEventLogger instance responsible for logging Chrome trace events.

methods.name: get_outermost_event
methods.description: Retrieves the outermost Chromium event name, or None if the event stack is empty.

methods.name: try_add_event_data
methods.description: Attempts to add event data to a Chromium event if it exists in the current event stack.

methods.name: None add_event_data( self, event_name: str, **kwargs: Any, )
methods.description: Adds metadata to an ongoing Chromium event, raising an error if the event is invalid.

methods.name: add_toplevel
methods.description: Adds metadata to the top-level Chromium event, typically used within dynamo_timed contexts.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Increments a metric counter associated with a specific Chromium event.

methods.name: increment_toplevel
methods.description: Increments a metric at the top-level event, useful for aggregating metrics across contexts.

methods.name: None add_to_set( event_name: str, log_level: CompileEventLogLevel, key: str, value: Any )
methods.description: Adds a value to a set associated with a specific event and key within Chromium logging.

methods.name: add_to_set_toplevel
methods.description: Adds a value to a set in the top-level Chromium event, simplifying set-based metrics.

methods.name: chromium
methods.description: Record metadata in Chromium trace logs for a specified event.

methods.name: pt2_compile
methods.description: Record metadata in PT2 compile events and Chromium logs for a specified event.

methods.name: compilation_metric
methods.description: Log compilation metrics at the top level, including relevant metadata and timing info.

methods.name: instant
methods.description: Immediately record an instant event with associated metadata and timestamp.

methods.name: try_add_pt2_compile
methods.description: Attempt to add metadata to a PT2 compile event, silently ignoring if the event is not active.

methods.name: try_
methods.description: Wrapper for quietly invoking a function if the Chromium log and metrics context are active.

methods.name: compile_time_record_function
methods.description: Context manager to profile compile-time sections with minimal overhead, using torch.profiler.

methods.name: dynamo_timed
methods.description: Main context manager for profiling Dynamo compilation phases, logging timings, metrics, and events with optional wait counters.

methods.name: compile_times
methods.description: Retrieve timing metrics about Dynamo compilation, output in string or CSV format, optionally aggregated.

methods.name: dump_compile_times
methods.description: Logs the aggregated compile times at exit based on current metrics.

methods.name: set_compilation_metrics_limit
methods.description: Adjusts the maximum number of stored compilation metrics, pruning older entries.

methods.name: clear_compilation_metrics
methods.description: Clears all stored compilation metrics.

methods.name: get_compilation_metrics
methods.description: Returns the list of collected compilation metrics objects.

methods.name: None add_compilation_metrics_to_chromium(c: CompilationMetrics)
methods.description: Adds selected fields from a compilation metrics object into the Chromium event logs for profiling.

methods.name: Optional[str] _get_dynamo_config_for_logging()
methods.description: Serializes current Dynamo configuration state for logging and diagnostics.

methods.name: Optional[str] _compiler_config_for_logging()
methods.description: Serializes compiler configuration state for logging and diagnostics.

methods.name: Optional[str] _scrubbed_inductor_config_for_logging()
methods.description: Sanitizes and serializes the inductor config for logging, removing sensitive or non-serializable data.

methods.name: record_compilation_metrics
methods.description: Create and store a CompilationMetrics object from profiling data and logs, attaching contextual info.
